system_prompt:
You write controllers for an autonomous car at a road intersection.
Write the controller as a numbered list of rules. Each rule has the form:
If <condition>, <action>.
A condition may only use these Boolean propositions, combined with and, or, not: green_traffic_light, green_left_turn_light, opposite_car, car_from_left, car_from_right, pedestrian_at_left, pedestrian_at_right, pedestrian_in_front, side_car, stop_sign.
Each action is exactly one of: stop, go_straight, turn_left, turn_right.
The rules are checked from top to bottom, and the first rule whose condition is true decides the action.

specs.description: If a pedestrian is in front, the car eventually stops.
No unprotected left turn with an oncoming car.
Never go straight unless the light is green.
At a stop sign, the car eventually stops.
No right turn with a car from the left or a pedestrian on the right.
The controller always prescribes one of the four actions.
If a green light eventually shows, the car eventually moves.
If the light is not green, the car eventually stops.
No turns while a car comes from the left.
After a green light, the car eventually moves.
Right turn on a non-green light only with no car from the left.
Unprotected left turn only when no car comes from any direction.
At a stop sign with no cross traffic, the car eventually moves.
Never go straight into a pedestrian.
Right turn at a stop sign only with no car from the left.
